accuracy.body_dimensions: Samsung published width, height and thickness; S26 chassis radius 7 mm published in 2026 Q1 report; other radii visual estimates.
accuracy.screen_resolution: Samsung native panel resolution; active rectangle derived from published full diagonal and native aspect.
accuracy.screen_geometry: Concentric chassis/display corners; front hole location and bezel sizes are estimates pending measured artwork.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Rear positions scaled from official render measurements used by the icon collection. Individual lens collars; Ultra laser sensor distinguished from four cameras. Protrusion and internal optics illustrative, not CAD.
accuracy.finishes: Official finish names with approximate sRGB and material roughness.
accuracy.omissions: USB port, speaker perforations, antenna seams and Ultra S Pen silo pending detail pass.
